environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on a bare EC2 instance with PostgreSQL 14. Database role used by the application is 'app_user' which has BYPASSRLS privilege granted for migration purposes. RLS policies exist on tenant_records table but are not enforced for this role. No additional network segmentation or session validation middleware.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_records USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.infrastructure: Single EC2 t3.medium, no WAF, no reverse proxy
config.session_management: In-memory map, no HMAC or ownership validation
